summary: Marketing is accelerating on two major fronts: the China Going-Global joint report with IE targeting a September launch in Singapore, and the knowledge website redesign with SEO prioritization of Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, while urgent actions this week include finalizing the overseas social media agency and launching the Intelligent China webpage.
summaryDetail: The China Going-Global report with IE is the top priority, with a working title 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global' and a target launch at Singapore events (Tech in Asia and Tyson) in early September. This week, Felix needs to confirm event partnerships and push for paperwork, while Julie secures op-eds and the team translates content. Simultaneously, the knowledge website redesign is advancing: Joseph and Joker are iterating on designs that combine more articles, indices on the homepage, and improved UX, with a decision to remove videos as a separate category. SEO efforts are focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with the Intelligent China webpage launching this week and marketing driving traffic from July. Urgent this week: submit scoring for overseas social media advertising bid selection by July 23 noon, and prepare the Indonesia Emerging Markets program webpage. Also, publish the 'Disruptive Timing' paper news article and incorporate art indices into the summary for Professor Mei.
